## Domains
- id=soc | name=SOC & Detection Engineering | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/soc-detection-engineering | note=Mostly local analytics; optional enrichment is explicitly gated.
- id=threat-intel | name=Threat Intel & DFIR | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/threat-intel-dfir | note=Intel normalization runs local-first with optional external context lookups.
- id=network | name=Network & Exposure Security | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/network-exposure-security | note=Analysis is local by default; probes are network-labeled before execution.
- id=application | name=Application & API Security | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/application-api-security | note=Contract linting and policy checks process documents fully in-browser.
- id=cloud-iam | name=Cloud & IAM Security | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/cloud-iam-security | note=Policy linting is local; no cloud credentials are required by default.
- id=supply-chain | name=Software Supply Chain Security | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/software-supply-chain-security | note=SBOM and lockfile analysis remain local unless users opt into lookups.
- id=osint | name=OSINT & Reconnaissance | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/osint-reconnaissance | note=Primarily local query generation and normalization, with optional operator-initiated lookups.
- id=pentest | name=Pentest Utilities | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/pentest-utilities | note=Runs local by default with explicit authorized-testing guardrails and no silent egress.
- id=ai-llm | name=AI / LLM Security | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/ai-llm-security | note=Analysis executes in-browser; optional network checks are explicit and policy-gated.
- id=data-privacy | name=Data Security & Privacy Engineering | url=https://cybertools.hub/domains/data-security-privacy-engineering | note=Privacy-focused tools prioritize local-only processing and explicit consent.
